notes.title: Some Dev Updates - The project is moving forward!
notes.notes: [p]Hi! This post is just a summary of several recent improvements the game has received.[/p][p]Many thanks to the community of testers on Discord who are helping me fix many bugs and suggesting relevant improvements :)[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]New dynamic weather: experience intense rain events for an even more captivating atmosphere![/p][/*][*][p]More cutscenes, better transitions between scenes[/p][/*][*][p]More animations and overall animation improvements: In idle mode, characters benefit from more variable animations, to make them more lively. The transition between their animations has also been improved. Important to note that the long-term goal is to have MetaHuman quality characters. However, I prefer to move forward with the characters I have at the moment. Technically, things are done in such a way that it will not prevent me from replacing the current characters with better ones in the long term.[/p][/*][*][p]More dialogues and micro scenes in the streets, to deepen the lore and reinforce the lively side[/p][/*][*][p]New side activity link to the loyalty system: identify anti-imperial behaviors[/p][/*][*][p]Better minimap, new world map[/p][/*][*][p]Level streaming with real home menu[/p][/*][*][p]Multi saves system[/p][/*][*][p]Advancements in the story integration[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554564/13e83275224060938840948b86611ca9ec24847b.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554564/4bd01f2d8a2c78641e345b9c349be744d2daa294.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554564/0a5d7f6cbdd34187eb7cd3bc7748dbcef4e38fde.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554564/5ed4a6dda40e73a684fdd3462d18610a3d9efa6d.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Improved in-game lighting
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Mandated Fate has received an upgrade to its lighting effects.
Including:
> New neon lights
> Floor lights
> Improved contrast
> Improved tint

This helps bring out the dark and haunting atmosphere of the District and the Imperial Capital.

notes.title: New Drivable vehicles and Day and Night Cycle!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! 

I finally added drivable vehicles to Mandated Fate! With the map getting larger, it felt like a necessary step — and I hope it will open up new, fun gameplay possibilities. There's also now a working vehicle damage system to make it feel more dynamic and reactive. 

On top of that, daytime is finally in! Until now, the game was stuck in endless night. Adding daylight allowed me to explore a whole new range of lighting moods and atmosphere. Still a work in progress, but I hope you enjoy the direction it’s taking!

notes.title: NEW NPC: Meet ISU-1
notes.notes:
ISU-1 is the result of a new surveillance program launched by the G.A.T.E. (Greater American Technological Empire). Its purpose is to ensure more flexible monitoring at a lower cost. Equipped with multiple cameras, ISU-1 patrols streets and building halls to make sure that “everything is in order.”


[list]
[*] This autonomous unit reacts to your presence.
[*] Your behavior around it may influence your loyalty rating.
[*] Comply, and your dedication to the Empire will be noted.
[*] Avoid, tamper, or act suspiciously, and your behavior may be… re-evaluated.
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/rkEN3Mp.jpg[/img]

In certain situations, you may need to avoid detection to achieve specific objectives.
Remember: ISU-1 is always watching—so the Empire doesn’t have to.
